newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet prices firmer in balanced trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet prices firmer in balanced trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were firmer in early business but thin demand left the market tracking volatile benchmark gas oil futures.
Traders said barge and cargo premiums strengthened a little to counter sharp afternoon losses on gas oil but with most prompt requirements covered outright levels were difficult to establish.

They said the market was generally balanced and so far the lack of extra material anticipated as a result of the British Airways strike helped underpin and strengthen premiums to the weaker afternoon gas oil screen despite the lack of buying.
Barges talked $1 firmer at around August IPE +$16/18 a tonne fob ARA with cargoes up a similar amount at August IPE +$17/+$19 a tonne cif NWE.
